name: Grafana-Image-Renderer
description: A Grafana remote image renderer that handles rendering panels & dashboards to PNGs using headless chrome. Read Grafana Image Renderer documentation and see usage instructions at readme link. In order to use this as a plugin of your Grafana docker instance you must add this enviromental arguments to that container: - GF_RENDERING_SERVER_URL: http://renderer-ip:8081/render - GF_RENDERING_CALLBACK_URL: http://grafana-ip:3000/ Change the IP (and the ports) to suit your configuration.
